span.span: MedAgentBench FHIR server: 300 physician-written tasks (+15 added), 100 de-identified patients
2 open-weight agents; one greedy and one sampled run per task
Step checker: identity, lab before order, dose rule, grounding, claimed vs. issued orders
8 fault types (F1–F8), one known edit per copy
Severity tier S0–S3, mapped to NCC MERP
Views: V1 answer, V2 + calls, V3n/V3 + observations
Paired Δ\Delta by fault type, view, instruction
Critical miss rate; Δ\Delta by severity tier
Natural runs: grader vs. step checker
All agent runs, graded by the benchmark
Strict step checker on every run
